n_training_samples.description: ED-31: training-side telemetry (SAELens' packed/windowed token counter, e.g. WandB's details/n_training_samples), never an A1 identity target -- packing (BOS separators, concatenation, fixed-size windowing) is a training-time transformation applied to the corpus, not a property of it. If supplied, cross-checked advisory-only against the replayed document-stream token_count/doc_count within a structural sanity band derived from the known packing policy (interplab.corpus.replay.expected_packed_token_range): only a gross, order-of-magnitude mismatch fails the run -- the small delta packing legitimately introduces never does. Omit when there is no training run to reconcile against (fresh/exploratory corpus registration).

census_sample_docs.description: ED-28 coverage: if supplied, the census only accumulates term matches over the first N documents of the (already subset_spec-bounded) stream -- coverage becomes 'sampled' and affected rows 'estimated'. A1's manifest is unaffected: it still reflects the whole consumed stream. Omit for coverage: 'full'.
